description: Stack of avatars with a visible limit, overlap and a count of extra participants.

howToUse: Use it to show who takes part in something in little space: members of a project, people in a conversation.
Pass the `items` in a stable order and limit with `max`; the rest becomes "+N".
Use `onOverflowClick` to open the full list, and `onItemClick` to open a person.
alternatives: A list of people with name and role: PersonCell in a list or Table.

keyboard.action: With `onItemClick` or `onOverflowClick`, moves through the avatars and the "+N".
Opens the person or the full list.

props.name: items
props.description: People, in the order they should appear (stable order, first on top).

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum visible avatars; the rest becomes "+N" with a tooltip. Default 4.

props.name: size
props.description: Size inherited from the Avatar atom. Default "md".

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: If present, each avatar becomes a button (focus + Enter/Space).

props.name: onOverflowClick
props.description: If present, "+N" becomes a button (e.g. open the full member list).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
